Gavaskar Criticizes Shamar Joseph's Actions After West Indies T20 Win

Former Indian cricketer Sunil Gavaskar has criticized West Indies bowler Shamar Joseph for his on-field actions following the West Indies' victory in the 4th T20I. Gavaskar stated that Joseph was "trying to attack Arshdeep" and advised him to "aim at the stumps, not him."
